title: Workbench
reference: repeat 2 { F1 F1 turn_right F1 turn_right } def F1 { forward forward activate }
hints: Two rows of switches joined at one end. Every switch is the same two steps away.
Put the walk-and-switch in F1. A loop around F1 F1, turn, F1, turn covers the bench.
